question: Should OpenClaw support a raw Dockge/Portainer-style Compose startup path, and if so which auth, bind, and Control UI origin values must be explicitly provided or persisted before the gateway starts?
rationale: The request is useful setup UX, but the implementation changes the gateway exposure boundary and may add new config/env/default behavior; automation cannot choose that policy safely.

options.title: Define setup-time bootstrap
options.body: Approve a Docker-manager bootstrap contract that validates env/setup inputs, writes canonical config, and starts the gateway only after auth and origin policy are durable.

options.title: Keep explicit setup required
options.body: Keep the current fail-closed raw Compose behavior and document that `scripts/docker/setup.sh` or manual config seeding is required before managed-stack startup.

options.title: Narrow to related issues
options.body: Treat custom origins and trusted-proxy automation as separate smaller items and leave this broader raw-startup request unresolved until those land.

recommendation.title: Define setup-time bootstrap
recommendation.body: Approve a Docker-manager bootstrap contract that validates env/setup inputs, writes canonical config, and starts the gateway only after auth and origin policy are durable.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice centers on the gateway startup and remote-access security boundary where steipete has the strongest relevant history.
